verdict.rationale: Apple ships official, first-party SDKs for building on Apple silicon. These include Metal and Metal 4, with ML integration and a Metal debugger, plus MLX, an array framework from Apple machine learning research built on the unified memory model, and Metal-backed PyTorch acceleration. Together they give developers a sanctioned way to build ML/AI workloads on the M4 Max. missing for 10: in-depth evidence of SDK API references, language bindings and install/versioning details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against these SDKs on M4 Max.
